map.放射性活度 A=λ·N=(ln2/T½)·N：单位时间衰变次数，λ 为衰变常数、: Radioactive activity A = λ·N = (ln2/T½)·N is the number of decays per unit time, where λ is the decay constant, N the number of nuclei and T½ the half-life.
map.A 单位贝可(Bq，1 次衰变/秒)；医疗常用千贝可(kBq)、兆贝可(MBq): A is in becquerels (Bq, one decay per second); medicine commonly uses kilobecquerels (kBq) and megabecquerels (MBq). Activity decays exponentially with time as A(t) = A₀·e^(-λt).
map.活度反映衰变速率而非总量危险度，辐射安全还需结合射线类型与能量；结果仅供参考。: Activity reflects the decay rate rather than the total hazard; radiation safety also depends on the radiation type and energy, so the result is for reference only.
